Cadmus is seeking a Junior Full Stack Developer to support a file management application team serving a federal government health care organization. The role contributes to development and maintenance of secure file-transfer capabilities and an anticipated application redesign.

Responsibilities
This role provides full-stack software development support to a file management application team, a high-performing Agile team responsible for delivering enterprise platforms and shared services that support multiple systems at a federal government health care organization
Collaborate with senior developers, product owners, and DevOps engineers to design, develop, test, and deploy scalable applications on cloud infrastructure
Develop responsive and interactive user interfaces using Angular and /or React
Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python and/or JavaScript (NodeJS)
Design, implement, and integrate REST APIs with frontend applications and third-party services
Deploy, configure, and maintain applications on AWS cloud services
Work in Linux environments for application deployment, troubleshooting, and automation
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following coding standards
Participate in code reviews, debugging, testing, and performance optimization
Collaborate with cross-functional teams using Agile/Scrum methodologies
Troubleshoot production issues and assist in maintaining application availability

Required
1–2 years of hands-on experience building and maintaining web applications using modern frontend and backend technologies
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
1–2 years of experience in full stack web development - Python, JavaScript, NodeJS
Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, or similar)
Proficiency with Git and collaborative development workflows
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins CJE) and DevOps practices
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes
Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript/TypeScript
Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and test-driven development
Comfortable in stepping out of the comfort zone to suggest, test, implement new technologies and frameworks
Ability to independently research and suggest solutions for ongoing improvement including new frameworks and infrastructure requirements
A passion for scaling software, ensuring high availability enjoyment of automation and demonstrate a proactive approach to detecting and resolving issues
Must be a self-starter
Strong communication skills - both written and verbal. The ability to articulate ideas to non-technical audience
Agile oriented in approach to engineering and operations, including being comfortable with ambiguity in a flat organization
Believe in a quick improvement approach: Fail fast, learn fast, improve fast
Candidates must be eligible to work in the United States as a U.S Perm Resident or U.S. Citizen
Preferred
Added project-relevant areas such as S3, ECS/Fargate, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, IAM, KMS, RBAC, secure APIs, and file-processing security
Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka, or Amazon SQS
Experience implementing authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT, SAML)
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools
Knowledge of security best-practices for web applications
Experience working in a DevOps-oriented environment
Configure and manage Nginx as a web server and reverse proxy or has experience with similar technologies like Tomcat, Apache
Familiarity with AI Assisted coding practices/tools (Co-Pilot, Cursor etc.)
Benefits
Based on eligibility and job status: medical, dental, and vision benefits; company paid disability and life insurance; 401(k) program; paid time off (PTO); paid holidays; voluntary time off (VTO); tuition reimbursement; adoption assistance program; other optional benefits; and various bonus programs.
